_doc: Orc gait variant C, the MIDDLE orc (Mike 2026-10-17: lower than B, higher than the main orc; 'very good'). Every posture value sits about halfway between orc_b.json and orc.json; the spine is at the 30 deg cap. stride_scale 0.89: 0.92 and 0.95 gave a calf hitch at the run's loop seam in the non-limp path. Limp between B's and the main orc's, MIRRORED (mirror_sides: weak RIGHT leg, strong LEFT leg, low leading left shoulder) so it differs from the other two. Walk and run only; the idles stay the main orc's (as_orc_warrior_c derives from as_orc_warrior). Clips taom_orc_c_* on as_orc_warrior_c. Read by tools/blender/restyle_human_clip.py. Angles in degrees, distances in metres.
